verdict.rationale: This axis fairly applies to a state online filing portal. However, no evidence item mentions operating-hours windows, per-day filing limits, or session timeouts on the online flows. The pack describes only available services, notifications and help videos, so there is no evidence that such constraints are published up front.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
